page.overview:
Who is Masked Mage?

The Masked Mage is a non-playable character from Final Fantasy XIV. A lower-ranked Ascian, he serves as the main antagonist in the early portions of A Realm Reborn, stirring up conflict in the Black Shroud, La Noscea, or Thanalan depending on the player's starting class. His name is never learned before his demise.

The Masked Mage's exact role varies depending on which city-state the adventurer began their journey in, which is in turn dictated by their starting class. Regardless of the region, he was defeated with the aid of a member of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, and with his last words confirmed the Ascians' involvement in Eorzea's recent troubles, leading the assisting Scion to explain their nature to the adventurer.

If the adventurer began as a Marauder or Arcanist, they encountered the Masked Mage in La Noscea. Trailing Sevrin at the behest of Staelwyrn, they found him encountering a coalition of Serpent Reavers, who had apparently entered into an agreement with the Masked Mage. At their signal, he conjured a golem to attack Sevrin and the adventurer, the latter able to defeat the golem, much to the Mage's shock.

Later, after the adventurer helped the Yellowjackets fend off a Serpent Reaver attack on Swiftperch, the Masked Mage confronted them in person, summoning a voidsent to attack the adventurer. Y'shtola Rhul arrived to assist in defeating both the voidsent and the Mage, who lamented his defeat at the hands of "mere mortals".
